prompt:
Create one UI mockup image showing two mobile screens side by side for TripLOG: the itinerary page with a new summary button, and the summary sheet opened from that button. Preserve the existing TripLOG design system and compact, consistent Korean typography. Use white surfaces, dark #0b1020 text and thin borders, #fff05a yellow accents, pale blue and pale pink supporting accents, small rounded corners, and subtle hard shadows. Titles are 22px, section titles and place names 15px, controls and body 14px, supporting labels 12px, with comfortable touch targets.

On the left screen, retain the TripLOG header, visible sync button, itinerary page, horizontal DAY selector, compact timeline, bottom add-itinerary button, and bottom navigation. Place a small yellow “일정 요약” button next to “전체 일정” in the “일정 계획” heading area. The trip is “오사카·교토 가족여행”, dated “9.24–9.26”. Show DAY 1 selected and three itinerary places: “11:00 간사이국제공항”, “13:00 난바역”, “18:00 도톤보리”.

On the right screen, show a mobile summary bottom sheet over the itinerary page. Its header is “일정 요약” with a close icon, followed by “오사카·교토 가족여행” and “9.24–9.26 · 3일”. Use a compact overview row displaying “9개 일정” and “기록된 이동 2시간 35분”. Below, use three compact expandable day sections. DAY 1, “9.24 · 오사카”, is expanded, with metadata “11:00–19:00 · 3개 일정 · 이동 55분”, three neatly aligned time-and-place rows matching the left screen, and a small “이 날짜 일정 보기” action. DAY 2, “9.25 · 오사카”, is collapsed, with “09:00–18:00 · 3개 일정 · 이동 40분” and the concise route “오사카성 → 우메다 → 하루카스”. DAY 3, “9.26 · 교토”, is collapsed, with “09:00–18:00 · 3개 일정 · 이동 1시간” and “교토역 → 기요미즈데라 → 기온”. Clearly show expand/collapse chevrons. Keep a fixed footer with “요약 복사” and a yellow “일정으로 돌아가기” button. Keep the summary focused on a readable itinerary overview.

Input images:
- final-timeline-mobile.png: Existing TripLOG itinerary UI reference.
stage: mockup only; application code and deployment unchanged
